scope: PLAN section 9 fixture preparation only; live source mappings and independent method qualification remain due
candidate_binding: ctx.build_id, chart_id, state=building, conventions.fixture=true; current published head is refused
grain: chart x generation x class; exactly one canonical jury assertion per supplied class horizon

inputs.anchor: kala_core.assertion.AssertionEnvelope, stage=judge, role=selects; candidate identity and full source envelope
inputs.upstream_refs: nonempty pinned judge, negative_space, F1 and F2 references; fixture references do not admit live bindings
inputs.nodes_and_uses: typed evidence nodes and evaluated activity/roles; every anchor used_for_selection root is a selection use even when absent from anchor source roots; never recalculated sky or period values
inputs.opinions: already evaluated, class-scoped typed conclusions; operational contests, sequences and turning points require every root and group to have selection-safe, non-testimony corroboration on the same covered half-open interval; G-J only through complete MethodOutput
inputs.groups: all five declared schools, coverage, ancestry, source and review references; G-J overridden by complete-method admission; explicit corpus_admitted and kp_ingested gate G-T/G-K; G-A remains testimony
inputs.measure: explicit alpha and boolean exchangeability; pinned default 1023 non-identity shifts; separate pipeline null is unavailable without a selection producer
inputs.time_axis: aware UTC Unix seconds; one declared class horizon
inputs.reading_claims: Optional typed L2 signal mappings with explicit F1 predicate, class, phase, person, objects and episode; nonobservable, unmapped and unmatched claims retained with reasons; never scoring inputs
inputs.event_identity: Optional explicit class/phase/person/episode plus observable_event_ref; must match anchor class/person. No phase/episode inferred from text, dates or assertion identity

outputs.kala_jury_candidate: selection-safe evidence graph, group declarations, D(W), conditional null and explicit missing pipeline-null reason
outputs.kala_jury_candidate_segment: half-open boundaries, group support vectors and allowed source roots
outputs.kala_jury_candidate_contest: opposing typed conclusions kept as separate sides
outputs.provenance: full input envelope, pinned upstream references, fixture acceptance scope, canonical sequences and joint turning points from the declared class roster; reading_attachment_report: canonical event forecasts, deduplicated reading_attachments, unattached claims with reasons, and shared-episode evaluation clusters; preparation only, no issuance identity

compatibility: default Modes A-D and published readers unchanged; plan is read-only; substep replaces only its own candidate class, child tables first, inside the caller transaction
not_proven: live judge/F1/F2/negative-space mappings, complete production G-J producer, production output qualification, deployment and publication
